purpose: Dated support and verification inventory for repository capabilities and all 36 research recommendations.

status_definitions.implemented: Repository helper or contract is implemented and locally fixture-tested within its stated input scope.
status_definitions.implemented_with_limits: Concrete implementation is present; listed ingestion, automation or target-verification limits remain.
status_definitions.conditional: Detection, inspection or documented experiment is available; adopting or running the downstream capability requires target evidence.

verification_policy.note: Python fixtures exercise this skill's behavior. Source review, static configuration and helper tests do not establish downstream runtime compatibility, production readiness or performance gains.

local_verification.scope: Repository Python behavior and packaging fixtures only; configured CI Python 3.10/3.x execution is not asserted.

version_scope.target: Python >=3.10; local fixture execution on Python 3.12.14/Linux

support_constraints: Python standard library only

recommendation_coverage.title: Use one selected population for latency and runner usage
recommendation_coverage.implementation_scope: Immutable manifest selection and since filtering bind runs, jobs, attempts and usage to the same population.

recommendation_coverage.title: Resolve latest distinct runs and same-run attempts deterministically
recommendation_coverage.implementation_scope: Stable run chronology and event/branch/workflow identities prevent older successes from overriding newer failures.

recommendation_coverage.title: Exclude stale payloads after a failed refetch
recommendation_coverage.implementation_scope: Atomic publication and manifest-listed current payloads prevent fallback to stale job files.

recommendation_coverage.title: Observe actual rerun attempts and initial failure/recovery
recommendation_coverage.implementation_scope: Prior attempt retrieval and attempt-aware reliability metrics preserve incomplete history as unknown.

recommendation_coverage.title: Preserve complete required-policy scope and identities
recommendation_coverage.implementation_scope: Paginated rules, app/workflow identities, explicit protected target and source completeness retain known positives without treating inaccessible policy as absent.

recommendation_coverage.title: Evaluate required dependency closure instead of an incorrect floor rule
recommendation_coverage.implementation_scope: Complete explicit graphs support dependency closure, longest required paths and recomputed counterfactuals.
remaining_target_validation: Supply the expanded target graph and actual node timing; inferred job names cannot establish dependency completeness.

recommendation_coverage.title: Clean up timed-out descendant processes
recommendation_coverage.implementation_scope: POSIX group cleanup and negative process fixtures stop later trials when cleanup is incomplete.

recommendation_coverage.title: Keep warmup failures visible
recommendation_coverage.implementation_scope: Warmups are recorded with status and cleanup evidence; failures stop trials unless explicitly allowed.

recommendation_coverage.title: Capture experiment provenance before execution
recommendation_coverage.implementation_scope: Source, dirty-content fingerprint and metadata snapshots precede warmup and are rechecked after execution.

recommendation_coverage.title: Distinguish overlapping work from elapsed step coverage
recommendation_coverage.implementation_scope: Interval-union step coverage is separate from summed step work and workflow structural hints.
remaining_target_validation: Native parallel-step execution and platform cleanup behavior require target runtime verification.

recommendation_coverage.title: Make API collection bounded, rate-aware and explicit about recall
recommendation_coverage.implementation_scope: Serial retries, timeout handling, API version, conditional ETags, date/workflow filters and truncation/retention metadata are implemented.
remaining_target_validation: Partition larger studies into explicit server-side date/workflow windows; automatic partitioning and webhook ingestion are not implemented.

recommendation_coverage.title: Strengthen comparison statistics and equal-workload controls
recommendation_coverage.implementation_scope: Paired trials, deterministic confidence analysis, low-sample states and explicit cohort/workload metadata are implemented.
remaining_target_validation: Normalize runner-specific workload reports and supply equal-workload evidence; there is no universal JUnit/Go/browser report parser.

recommendation_coverage.title: Separate diagnostic timing, authoritative gate evidence and pricing
recommendation_coverage.implementation_scope: Dated price inputs, raw/rounded usage, explicit required-gate policy and candidate-bound normalized evaluation are implemented.
remaining_target_validation: Supply complete provider check/event correlation, verified provenance, billing context and telemetry; these are not automatically collected for every provider.

recommendation_coverage.title: Reject skipped or neutral observations as unproven green
recommendation_coverage.implementation_scope: Diagnostic proxies and policy evaluation require explicit current successful evidence; an intentional skip requires its own verified contract.

recommendation_coverage.title: Support native parallel/background workflow reasoning
recommendation_coverage.implementation_scope: Discovery, recursive JSON inspection, overlap metrics and migration gates are implemented; native platform execution remains unverified.

recommendation_coverage.title: Model service-enforced cache access
recommendation_coverage.implementation_scope: Explicit mode sets and caller-limit validation are implemented in the advisory inspector; service enforcement must be checked on target.

recommendation_coverage.title: Recognize action lockfiles and immutable dependency identities
recommendation_coverage.implementation_scope: Static identity/lockfile checks and plan-qualified generation guidance are implemented; live reachability and complete expansion remain unverified.

recommendation_coverage.title: Choose concurrency by workflow purpose
recommendation_coverage.implementation_scope: Static queue incompatibilities and integration freshness/starvation evidence are checked; actual scheduling and branch policy require target validation.

recommendation_coverage.title: Prepare for the public privileged-trigger default change
recommendation_coverage.implementation_scope: Dated applicability and review instructions are documented; no policy bypass or privileged-trigger conversion was enabled.

recommendation_coverage.title: Keep retention loss and collection completeness explicit

recommendation_coverage.title: Separate approval wait from runner queue
